items.label: Canbus Error Free Design
items.value: Our 3157 LED bulb adopts the latest built-in intelligent IC driver, with high wattage making the LED bulb compatible with more vehicles. For most cars, there is no need to modify the original car circuit, and the original bulb can be replaced directly, plug and play. However, a few special vehicles may encounter abnormal canbus or installation problems, which may require load resistors to solve the problem.

items.label: 50,000 Hours Lifespan
items.value: Our 3157 LED Bulb is made of aviation aluminum, which has better heat dissipation and durability. It also has a 12000rpm turbo cooling fan, which can quickly transfer heat and greatly reduce the need for frequent replacement.

items.label: 400% Brighter than Halogen
items.value: iFunyLed 3157 led light is built with 36 pieces of 2525 high brightness led chips per bulb, generating 3440lm super bright output per pair. Being able to help others notice your vehicle faster and more clearly even in poor lighting conditions.

items.label: Compatible Socket
items.value: 3157, 3056, 3156, 3457, 3057, 4057, 4157, etc. If you are unsure which bulb model is suitable for your vehicle, please refer to your owner's manual for confirmation, which is the most accurate.

items.label: Professional Service
items.value: We are committed to providing good customer experience, if you have any questions about our product, please do not hesitate to contact us.
